correctness.rationale: Fix an arbitrary triple line on any smooth complex cubic threefold X. Smoothness forces its two transverse normal binary quadratics to have no common zero, and uniqueness of tritangent plane gives a basepoint-free pencil. The pencil intersects the conic of perfect squares at two distinct points, permitting coordinates with linear cubic terms s^2u+t^2v and w normal to the unique tangent plane. Triple-line plane restriction yields F=s²u+t²v+sQ0+tQ1+R3 with no w² in Q0,Q1, and R3(0,0,w)=k w³, k!=0. In a nearby-line Fano chart (u,v,w)=(as+bt,cs+dt,es+ft), four Fano equations have identity linear derivative in a,b,c,d, so a,b,c,d vanish to order 3 in (e,f). The restricted transverse-gradient determinant then has quadratic jet exactly -6kef and Hessian determinant -36k². I independently expanded the lowest-order general cubic jet symbolically to check -6kef and the Hessian, agreeing with the inspected SymPy verifier. Formal Morse lemma gives a node and intrinsic Fitting_1 Ω singular scheme reduced length one at each triple line. Bockondas–Boissière Theorem 6 supplies set-theoretic singular support exactly at triple lines. Works for every smooth complex cubic, including reducible divisor, but not positive characteristic.

originality.rationale: The original Bockondas–Boissière paper proves singular support is triple lines, defines the determinant divisor, and explicitly asks in Remark 9 whether all its singularities are nodal. The universal nondegenerate -6kef quadratic jet answers that specific open local analytic question. Lahoz–Naranjo–Rojas discusses the divisor class and another curve, not universal local singularity of this determinant. Strong originality evidence is the open question in the primary full text, though later independently discovered answers cannot be excluded.
residual_risks: An answer to Bockondas–Boissière Remark 9 may appear in later unindexed mathematics literature.
Local analytic proof uses characteristic zero and standard determinantal divisor structure, not arbitrary schemes or positive characteristic.

value.rationale: A direct resolution of an explicitly stated problem for a natural Fano-surface determinantal divisor, including exact formal local ring, multiplicity and reduced singular subscheme for every smooth complex cubic threefold. The universal local quadratic jet supplies precise singularity type beyond previously known support and genus/class information.

limitations: Smooth cubic threefolds over C only, with second-type divisor defined by the standard determinant.
Does not assert irreducibility, number of triple lines, or all characteristic generalizations.
